page.overview:
Who is Andrew?

Andrew was a Human male who served as a lieutenant in the Resistance 30 years after the Battle of Endor. He helped General Leia Organa, Finn, C-3PO and BB-8 collect fuel, ammo and Wookiee Cookies for the Millennium Falcon shortly before the Battle of Starkiller Base.
